name: Find a buyer group rivals miss and brief ads
why: Finds an overlooked group of buyers and their own words, a useful input to the buying-group messages skill.

name: Buyer trigger and proof mapper
why: Maps what starts a purchase and the proof each buyer needs, the same thinking behind trigger events in the target account profile.

name: Prepare a webinar people can follow
why: Builds a teaching outline and promotion plan for one clear result, matching the session step of the webinar programme.

name: Plan an event follow up that earns a reply
why: Turns attendee lists and event notes into grouped follow-up drafts with every promise tracked.

name: Follow-up email sequence writer
why: Writes follow-ups with a new reason each time and a stop rule, for nurture after a webinar or campaign.

name: Lead grader
why: Grades leads by how soon they need to act, a simple first step before a full scoring rule.

name: Weekly sales pipeline reviewer
why: Reviews the deal export each week, the sales-side view that the monthly pipeline review builds on.

name: Cold email claim checker
why: Tests each claim in an outreach email before it goes out, so buying-group messages stay checkable.

name: Marketing scorecard builder
why: Puts slow brand measures beside pipeline numbers, useful when out-of-market buyers matter as much as leads.

name: Split your marketing budget between brand and sales
why: Helps decide how much goes to reaching future buyers versus capturing today's demand.

name: X and LinkedIn post pair writer
why: Writes LinkedIn posts for speakers and staff that promote a webinar or event in their own voice.
